entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: An Icatian commander and mercenary wizard who stoked conflict among Sarpadia's species, whose subterfuge led to the destruction of dwarven cities.

entities.name: Tamun
entities.description: A dwarven woman who chooses Reod as mate and escapes Teedmar with him.

entities.name: Melelki
entities.description: Dwarf supplier of explosive dragon eggs.

entities.name: Sekena
entities.description: A dwarf who leaves with two hatched whelps and later brings her dragon to rescue the group.

entities.name: Kolevi
entities.description: Elder Druid of Havenwood who hires Reod.

entities.name: Lalani
entities.description: Elder Druid of Havenwood who hires Reod.

entities.name: Kistefar
entities.description: Emissary of the Havenwood elves.

entities.name: Andli
entities.description: Elven child who helps Reod escape prison.

entities.name: Eliza
entities.description: Reod's long-time friend turned Farrelite who saves him from torture.

entities.name: Genkr Nik
entities.description: Ebon Hand teacher of Reod who tortures him.

entities.name: Hamon
entities.description: Dwarf elder of Gurn Keep.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Black-aligned order that Reod joined; its thrulls rebel.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: Elven forest that traded thrull flesh to make thallids.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Creatures made by the elves by fusing thrull flesh with fungus, given limited intelligence by a ward.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures of the Ebon Hand who rebel at Reod's urging.

entities.name: Teedmar
entities.description: Dwarven town buried by a volcanic eruption.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Dwarven town destroyed by the orc-goblin army.

entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: Dwarven keep besieged and overrun by the orc-goblin army.

entities.name: Achtep Keep
entities.description: Stronghold of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Region of goblins and orcs.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent where the story occurs.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Human nation Reod served.

events.summary: Reod arranges a trade deal between the Ebon Hand and Havenwood that creates thallids, and is hired by the Elder Druids to distract Icatia.
events.quote: creating the thallids , a plentiful, if somewhat bland, food source

events.summary: Reod forms a truce between goblins and orcs of the Crimson Peaks to harass Icatia, but the elves cut the contract.
events.quote: However, the contract was cut abruptly, leaving Reod without funds and a hazardous situation on his hands.

events.summary: Reod's dispute with Melelki over dragon eggs destroys the dwarves' house; his seduction spell on Tamun backfires and they fall in love.
events.quote: the dwarf's heat caused the spell to backfire, and both fell in love

events.summary: Reod's attempt to blow up the thallid farm fails and instills limited intelligence in the thallids; Sekena leaves with two whelps.
events.quote: instilling a limited form of intelligence in the thallids

events.summary: Reod is captured by the elves and imprisoned, then escapes with Andli's help and blows up buried eggs, causing a great fire in the stronghold.
events.quote: causing a great fire in the stronghold

events.summary: Reod meets Eliza, is abducted to Achtep Keep, betrays Genkr Nik by starting a thrull rebellion, and is saved by Eliza.
events.quote: Reod betrays the deal by starting a rebellion among the Hand's thrulls

events.summary: Reod reaches besieged Gurn Keep and is imprisoned by suspicious dwarves; without his direction the keep falls to the goblins.
events.quote: the keep is invaded by the goblins

events.summary: Reod finds Melelki and Tamun and Sekena's dragon carries them away; Tamun still wants to marry him.
events.quote: she still wanted to marry him

relations.note: Fell in love after the spell backfired

relations.quote: Genkr discovered this and started to torture Reod but was saved by Eliza
his teacher when he was an acolyte
He changed his name when he joined the Order of the Ebon Hand .
